name: Garden Reception
description:
Garden Reception — $2,295

Complete reception setup for up to 80 guests

Create an elegant outdoor reception without having to select every rental individually. Our Garden Reception Package provides the essential tent, tables, seating, linens, centerpieces, and lighting for up to 80 guests, with professional setup and breakdown included.

Your package includes:

One 20′ × 40′ Pole Tent
Eight 5′ Round Banquet Tables
Eighty Gold Chiavari Chairs
Eight Premium Table Linens
Eight Rustic Lantern Table Centerpieces — one per guest table
Perimeter String Lighting around the tent
Professional Setup & Breakdown of included rental equipment

Please Note: This package is designed for up to 80 guests. The tent is a pole tent with interior center poles, and the final table arrangement may vary depending on the event location and site conditions.

Not Included: Plates, chargers, glassware, flatware, napkins, table settings, floral arrangements beyond the included Rustic Lantern Centerpieces, dance floor, sidewalls, draping, cocktail tables, or other décor/rentals not specifically listed above. Items shown in styled photos that are not listed as included are for presentation purposes only.

Travel/delivery fees and applicable sales tax are additional and calculated separately.
